description: MISSING_TAGS scenario for a yoga studio with no meta description or og tags.

agentOutput.text:
I'll analyze that page for you with those target keywords in mind. Let me fetch the current SEO tags first.
Now I'll create 3 optimized suggestions for each tag based on your target keywords: "yoga classes Seattle," "Vinyasa yoga," and "certified yoga instructor."
## Analysis Summary

Your page currently has significant SEO gaps that are preventing it from ranking for your target keywords. Here's what I found and why my suggestions will help:

**Title Tag Issues:**
Your current title "Yoga Classes" is extremely generic and only 12 characters—far too short to compete in search. It completely misses all three of your target keywords. My suggestions front-load "Yoga Classes Seattle" or "Vinyasa Yoga Classes" to immediately signal geographic and practice-style relevance, while staying within the optimal 50-60 character range. The first option includes your studio name for brand recognition, while the second and third options emphasize certified instructors as a trust signal.

**Meta Description—Currently Missing:**
You have no meta description at all, which means Google will auto-generate one from your page content. This is a huge missed opportunity. My three suggestions all stay within 150-160 characters and include clear calls to action ("Book today," "Start your journey," "Try your first class free"). Each weaves in all three keyword themes naturally while highlighting differentiators like "all levels welcome" and "welcoming community" to improve click-through rates.

**H1 Optimization:**
Your current H1 is "Zen Flow Yoga Studio," which is fine for branding but doesn't target any search keywords. The H1 should tell both users and search engines what the page is about. My first two suggestions directly incorporate all three keyword themes in natural, readable ways. The third option leads with emotional benefit while still including the primary keyword phrase, which can appeal to users at the awareness stage of their search journey.

**Key Improvements:**
- Geographic targeting now present (Seattle)
- Primary style specified (Vinyasa)
- Trust signals added (certified instructors)
- Better character length utilization
- Clear user intent matching for local yoga class searches

Would you like me to refine any of these, try different keywords, or analyse additional tags (e.g. og:title, canonical URL)?
